title: orion check: speak only when something changed (update offer, rules fingerprint, per-repository record, personal rules offer)
summary: Makes the session-start check speak only on a real change: no update offer at the installed version, a rules fingerprint that ignores line endings, one record per repository shared by its worktrees, a fresh clone asked once, and a personal rules offer that is not repeated daily. Built and pushed; released after three review rounds with one finding left (stderr on a broken pipe when the cache folder is read-only, red on CI only).
friction: three review rounds each found a different regression in per-computer state (one record overwritten by worktrees on different rules; a cache file shared with older scripts under a new meaning; a broken-pipe line on stderr) - about 80 minutes and a released story; one story carried five fixes to the same state

the local gate (the suite in WSL plus the Windows part) was green, 219 of 219, while CI failed one check: the CI runner ignores SIGPIPE and the local shells do not, so a stderr check passed locally and failed on CI
lessons_learned: A change to a per-computer record of the check hook is tested with an older orion.sh running beside the new one (another project, and another worktree of the same clone), opened in alternation: each of two review rounds found a repeat only there
A check that asserts empty stderr is also run with SIGPIPE ignored, as the CI runner does; a pipeline is silenced on both sides, or the function returns early when its folder cannot be written
